div.div: قَعِيرٌ Deep; having a remote bottom; (A, K;) applied to a river; as also ↓ قَعُورٌ , accord. to the K; but this is not mentioned by any one before the author of the K, and is a mistake for ↓ قَعُّورٌ , which occurs afterwards in the K. (TA.) You say بِئْرٌ قَعِيرَةٌ, (A,) and ↓ قَعُّورٌ , (K, TA,) A deep well; (K, TA;) a well having a remote bottom. (TA.) And قَصْعَةٌ قَعِيرَةٌ (S, A) (tropical:) A deep bowl. (TA.) ↓ قَعُورٌ is also applied as an epithet to a woman's vulva: (Ibn-Habeeb, TA in art. خجى:) and, accord. to the K, to a woman. (TA in that art.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
